name: wwtdigital
description: WWTDigital's shared catalog of Claude skills, grouped by category: presentation, research, ops, admin and tech. Install the bundles you need, or browse and download individual skills at the marketplace site.

plugins.name: presentation
plugins.description: Skills for anything you put in front of people: decks, documents, reports and copy, in the WWT house style.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Skills for finding things out and making sense of them: desk and market research, interviews, analysis and synthesis.

plugins.name: ops
plugins.description: Skills for running projects and teams: status reporting, staffing, risk tracking, SOW and estimate support.

plugins.name: admin
plugins.description: Everyday admin skills, plus tools for contributing to this marketplace: author a new skill and check an install.

plugins.name: tech
plugins.description: Skills for engineers and technologists: code review, architecture documentation, repo hygiene, prototyping.
